subject: Current Domestic Coal Stock at Thermal Power Plants & Subsidiary Dispatch Readiness
mp_name: Shri Rajesh Kumar Verma (Member of Parliament)
ai_drafted_response: As on date, total pithead coal stock across CIL subsidiaries stands at 84.6 Million Tonnes (MT). SECL and MCL have scaled daily off-take via computerized Rapid Loading Systems (RLS) to 1.85 MT/day, ensuring an average 18.5 days stock at critical thermal power stations.

subject: Overburden Removal (OBR) Environmental Reclamation & Eco-Park Development by CMPDI
ai_drafted_response: Under CMPDI oversight, 3,840 Hectares of backfilled overburden dumps have been biologically reclaimed with native flora in FY2025-26. 14 eco-parks have been created across Singrauli and Korba coalfields.
